provider: local
kind: issue
body: '**"CLAUSES (i) AND (ii) ARE NO LONGER OPEN" IS OVERSTATED (commit f820eff22,
  `Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:687-703`). Clause (i) is a SHEAF statement; what
  landed is a MODULE statement, and the missing step is named nowhere.**


  Clause (i) as the docstring itself states it: "an invertible sheaf on `C ×_k Spec
  k[ε]` trivial along `ε ↦ 0` is trivial **on the two base-changed charts of `S`**".
  `DualNumber.free_of_cyclic_mod_eps` (`Picard/DualNumberChartTriviality.lean:120`)
  is: an invertible `A[ε]`-**module** whose every element agrees with a multiple of
  a fixed `m` mod `(ε)·M` is `Module.Free`. Both are sorry-free and axiom-clean (I
  re-measured all ten new declarations; also non-vacuous — I instantiated the theorem
  at `M = A[ε]`, `m = 1`, and the Nakayama iteration at the nonzero nilpotent `(ε)`).


  THREE GAPS between them, none of which is a `rw`:

  1. **Sheaf → module.** No declaration takes an invertible sheaf on a base-changed
  chart to a `Module.Invertible` over the sections. This project does not even have
  an `IsInvertible` predicate on `Scheme.Modules` from mathlib — see the note at `Picard/LineBundlePullback.lean:56-64`
  — it uses the project-local `LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial`, and the one available
  bridge is `Scheme.LineBundle.isInvertible_of_restrict_iso` (`Picard/InvertibleGrBridge.lean`),
  which needs a trivialising chart already in hand. So sheaf-level (i) is not the
  module-level theorem plus bookkeeping.

  2. **Hypothesis shape.** (i) hypothesises triviality of the restriction along `ε
  ↦ 0`; the theorem hypothesises `∀ x, ∃ r, x - r • m ∈ (ε)•M`, i.e. that a specific
  `m` generates the reduction. Producing that `m` from the kernel condition on `Pic`
  is the real content and is not proved.

  3. **Carrier.** (i) is about the base change `C ×_k Spec k[ε]` restricted to a chart
  of `S`; the theorem is about `DualNumber A` for an abstract `A`. The identification
  is `DualNumber.baseChangeAlgEquiv` composed with `pullbackSpecIso` — which the module
  docstring mentions as the intended route but nothing performs.


  **Import evidence that no wiring exists:** `Pic0AbelianVariety.lean` does NOT import
  `DualNumberChartTriviality` or `NilpotentThickeningFree` (I computed both closures).

  k[ε]` trivial along `ε ↦ 0` is trivial **on the two base-changed charts of `S`**".
  `DualNumber.free_of_cyclic_mod_eps` (`Picard/DualNumberChartTriviality.lean:120`)

  at `M = A[ε]`, `m = 1`, and the Nakayama iteration at the nonzero nilpotent `(ε)`).

  chart to a `Module.Invertible` over the sections. This project does not even have
  an `IsInvertible` predicate on `Scheme.Modules` from mathlib — see the note at `Picard/LineBundlePullback.lean:56-64`
